info.title: Pitchou API
info.description: Create a personal key under Paramètres → API or use the service key provided by the Pitchou team. In Swagger UI, enter the key under Authorize. OAuth-enabled services can also use their access token.

get.description: Requires `dossiers:read`. Results are sorted by ascending Pitchou ID. Pass the returned `next_cursor` as `after` to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: ID of the last dossier on the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of dossiers per page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name, Onagre identifier, Pitchou number, or Démarches Numériques number.

parameters.name: followed
parameters.description: Filter by whether the key holder follows the dossier. Requires a personal key.

serviceBearer.description: A Pitchou personal key, service key, or OAuth 2.0 access token, depending on the integration configuration.

latest_comment.description: Present for personal keys with internal access to the dossier.

author_email.description: Email address of the Démarches Numériques agent when recorded. Requires internal access.

max_upload_size_bytes.description: Maximum file size in bytes. A null value means unlimited.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid token, or disabled account or service

RateLimited.description: Request quota exceeded for this client

ResourceNotFound.description: Resource unavailable or outside the caller's access
